svg.aria-label: Dinordle taxonomic tree: a horizontal rectangular cladogram in four states — a fresh round holding only Dinosauria, a mid-round descent from Dinosauria to Saltasaurinae with six ruled-out branches struck through at an aligned tip column, the solved round descending twenty nodes to Saltasaurus, and the same diagram inside a 360 pixel scroll container with the trunk pinned at the left edge
